title: Give Me The Reason
lyrics_plain:
What's there to say
There's not much to talk about
Whatever happened to our love
The love that we found
Yes it's true
And there's nothing new you can say
Give me the reason to want you back
Why should I love you again
Do you know
Tell me how
How to forgive and forget
Give me the reason to love you now
It's been a mighty long time
And the love that used to be
Ended the day you walked out
Never knew I'd ever be standing alone
And outside with no one to love
I was secure and so glad there was you to love
Whatever in the world would I ever do without us
But it's getting clear that I have to get over you
Give me the reason to want you back
Why should I love you again
Do you know
Tell me how
How to forgive and forget
Give me the reason to love you now
It's been a mighty long time
And the love that used to be
Ended the day you walked out
Never knew I'd ever be standing alone
And outside with no one to love
